_comment: Label sets nest: LABELS[:k] is the taxonomy at k. A degradation curve over k therefore isolates option count rather than which labels happened to be drawn. Rungs are the k values the sweep reports.

descriptions.billing: invoices, payments, refunds, duplicate or incorrect charges, subscription fees and credit notes
descriptions.technical: software bugs, outages, error messages, failing integrations and things that do not work as documented
descriptions.sales: pricing enquiries, quotes, new contracts, renewals, upgrades and prospects evaluating the product
descriptions.legal: contract drafting and review, terms of service, liability, indemnities, trademarks and disputes
descriptions.security: vulnerability reports, breaches, phishing, malware, access control failures and responsible disclosure
descriptions.hr: job applications, recruitment, employment terms, staff matters, leave, payroll and benefits
descriptions.product_feedback: feature requests, product suggestions, usability complaints and praise for how the product works
descriptions.account_admin: logins, passwords, multi-factor authentication, user seats, roles, permissions and account settings
descriptions.logistics: shipping, delivery dates, customs, warehousing, stock levels and returns of physical goods
descriptions.partnerships: resellers, referral agreements, technology integrations, joint ventures and co-marketing proposals
descriptions.press: journalists, analysts, interview requests, media enquiries, embargoes and public statements
descriptions.facilities: offices, buildings, desks, meeting rooms, parking, cleaning, utilities and workplace equipment
descriptions.compliance: audits, certifications such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001, regulatory filings and policy attestation
descriptions.procurement: vendor onboarding, purchase orders, supplier questionnaires, tenders and sourcing decisions
descriptions.training: onboarding sessions, courses, certification, documentation requests and customer enablement
descriptions.data_privacy: GDPR subject access requests, data deletion and export, consent, retention and cross-border transfer

group_descriptions.commercial: money and commercial relationships: what is charged, what is bought, what is sold and who sells it
group_descriptions.technology: the product itself: how it behaves, how it is administered and how people are taught to use it
group_descriptions.risk: obligation and exposure: contracts, security, regulatory duties and the handling of personal data
group_descriptions.workplace: running the organisation: the people in it, the premises, the physical goods and the public voice

_groups_comment: Used only by the two_stage framing: pick a group, then a label within it. Chosen so that at k=16 both stages are 4-option questions, which is inside the range part one found this model reliable at.
